C1552.title: Analysis of Seven Critical Vulnerabilities in Cross-Chain Bridges
C1552.summary: According to DefiLlama, cumulative stolen funds from cross-chain bridges have exceeded $2.8 billion, accounting for the majority of total stolen funds across the Web3 industry. The article provides a detailed analysis of seven critical vulnerabilities in cross-chain bridges, revealing the systemic security risks in bridging processes.

references.title: Understanding the Seven Key Vulnerabilities of Cross-Chain Bridges in One Article
